name: Acepyr
steps: Sign up at acepyr.com with an email address and a password, and confirm the code sent to you. You don't need a wallet.
Confirm that you are 18 or older and accept the terms and the testnet points notice.
Trade the five-minute markets with your testnet $ACEPYR. One trade in a week enters you in that week's tournament.
Optional: link a wallet in Settings by signing a message.
Optional: share your referral code. A referral counts only after your friend verifies an email address, links a wallet and joins the waitlist.
what: Acepyr says its testnet $ACEPYR has no value and a mainnet token is not committed. How the free testnet, the $5 waitlist award and referrals work.
behind: The company is named: Acepyr, Inc. No founder or chief executive is named, and no investors, funding or audit have been published. Get the next airdrop first We post new guides, claim openings and deadlines on Telegram and X. Join our Telegram Follow on X
costs: Signing up and trading on the testnet are free, and nothing can be bought. Trading fees are charged in testnet tokens. The $10 that the waitlist asks you to hold stays in your own wallet.
risks: You must be 18 or older. The terms block Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and other places under comprehensive US sanctions, and they ban getting around the block. There is no identity check at sign-up. The docs say a future mainnet token would require one. One account per person. Extra accounts, bots and scripts get you disqualified. Acepyr says it "will never DM you first, ask for your seed phrase
